disease.name: Earhead Bug
disease.severity_index: Can cause up to 30% yield loss if untreated

environmental_factors.temperature_humidity: Prefers humid environments with standing water
environmental_factors.soil_conditions: More severe in waterlogged paddy fields

region_specific_information.Andhra Pradesh: Higher prevalence in coastal districts due to high humidity
region_specific_information.Telangana: Common in irrigated rice fields with dense vegetation

early_stage: Grain discoloration at the milk stage
Increased presence of adult bugs in panicle area
mid_stage: Shriveled grains due to bug feeding
advanced_stage: Complete grain sterility and empty grains
Secondary fungal infections due to damaged grains

crop_management: Timely sowing and harvesting to avoid peak bug infestation
Maintain proper spacing between plants to improve air circulation
biological_control: Predatory birds & spiders help reduce bug populations
Neem oil spray @ 5 ml/L water repels adult bugs

cultural_practices: Use of light traps to monitor adult bug population
Manual removal of egg masses from leaves
biological_control: Application of Metarhizium anisopliae (Entomopathogenic fungus) to control nymphs
chemical_control: Malathion (Cythion, Chemiton) @ 400 ml/200L water per acre
